ideas.pitch: Real-time crop water-stress monitoring dashboard using localized satellite imagery and IoT weather inputs specifically calibrated for local Catalan agriculture.
ideas.title: LleidaAgriSens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring to a tangible regional industry, which local judges in Lleida will instantly recognize and value.

ideas.pitch: Low-latency augmented reality trail guide and safety assessment tool for hiking and rescue operations in the Pyrenees near Lleida.
ideas.title: PirenaikaAR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time mobile AR engineering, mimicking the technical depth of BaseScanning which impressed judges through polished, hardware-aware execution.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and risk-scoring platform tailored for local credit unions and regional financial cooperatives to detect suspicious transaction patterns.
ideas.title: SegreFlowAML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the architecture of Bito by combining graph intelligence and explainable models, which appeals directly to enterprise and fintech judges looking for serious compliance tools.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered meal planning and nutrition assistant optimized for traditional local Mediterranean diets and regional dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: NutriCatala
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon the prize-winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by delivering an immediately demonstrable consumer utility with a localized cultural twist.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision posture and swing analyzer for Padel players using pose estimation to provide real-time coaching feedback.
ideas.title: BioPadelMotion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning strategy of CricketVision_AI by applying pose estimation to a popular local sport (Padel is massive in Spain), ensuring high engagement and a striking live demo.
